title: Management of a maxillary lateral incisor with a type III palatogingival groove and 2 roots
html: The palatogingival groove is a developmental anomaly that originates in the central fossa and extends along the root surface, often resulting in periodontal, endodontic, or combined endodontic and periodontal involvement. The authors present a case of a type III palatogingival groove associated with a periodontal defect and a sinus tract managed successfully through surgical and regenerative treatment.
